description: Hidden halo: a ring of stones below the centre plane, with the vertical offset derived from the head's OWN height rather than invented as a depth, and a raised head to make room for it. Chosen over the single halo because it is the variant that also changes the METAL, so the case covers both the delegation and the head modulation.
knownLimitations: RING_FAMILIES_AWAITING_PROFESSIONAL_REVIEW: every dimension in this design is a software construction parameter. No rail width, shoulder proportion, signet table thickness, crossing clearance or settability judgment is asserted anywhere, and no qualified jewelry professional has reviewed this geometry. The variant's capability status is NOT_REVIEWED.

HALO_SETTING_METAL_ABSENT: the halo stones are real geometry and NO METAL IS GENERATED TO HOLD THEM. Sprint 25's own recorded boundary, unchanged by Sprint 28, and why the halo family is PARTIAL rather than CURRENT.
notes: Sprint 28 Ring Families v2: INITIAL_BASELINE for a newly executable ring family. Created by running the real pipeline; no existing baseline was modified.
